proposal.hypothesis: The selected parent (5742ad4218cf4186) runs serial whenever the full requested team would average fewer than 256 options per worker. Instead, cap the static OpenMP team to the number of 256-option work grains available, using the serial path only when that yields fewer than two workers. This tests whether partial use of the passed thread budget can parallelize medium workloads without idle workers, while preserving the existing generic grain and complete output coverage. Prior aggregate OpenMP means are close; no gain is assumed.

retained: Kept the serial path for nonpositive n, one-thread budgets, and work insufficient for at least two 256-option grains.
Set the OpenMP team size to min(threads, n / 256), allowing partial use of the passed budget instead of switching directly from the full team to serial.
Retained static scheduling, a team no larger than the passed thread budget, and one distinct output write per loop iteration.
